I told Hollis in a reply to his #central-team message that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is **382 seats**.

That number comes from Tobias's post in #central-team on Oct 14. Nothing posted in the channel since then changes it. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he can already see that post. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it doesn't need approval to share.
